patch_description: The current ansatz applies a fixed sequence of layers (RY, ring-CRZ, RX, skip-CRZ/CRY) exactly twice, sharing all parameter names between the two copies. Based on the recommendation to test whether additional shared-depth repetition improves performance without increasing parameter count, I add a third identical copy of the block (again reusing the same parameter names). This increases circuit depth/expressivity (more entangling layers to build up correlations) while keeping n_params unchanged at 122, testing whether the added depth pushes validation accuracy and combined score higher, similar to the depth-doubling effect observed between the first (0.87) and second (0.89) prior programs.
